verdict.stance: Neutral / Pan-MENA Wholesale Bank Anchored by CBL & KIA Ownership (BBB-)
verdict.summary: Bank ABC is Bahrain's flagship wholesale banking group ($48.5bn assets, >$1.03bn 9M26 operating income, $204m 9M26 net profit) backed by Central Bank of Libya (59.4%) and Kuwait Investment Authority (29.7%). Solid Q326 capitalization (CAR 16.7%, CET1 13.3%) balances sovereign-exposure volatility in Egypt, Brazil, and Jordan.

positives: Scale wholesale franchise ($48.5bn assets) with diversified MENA, Brazil (Banco ABC Brasil), and Europe revenue.
Capitalization strengthened to 16.7% Total CAR (13.3% CET1) at Q326 vs 16.0% at YE25.
S&P BBB- Stable rating underpinned by conservative ECL provisioning and KIA minority backing.
negatives: Wholesale-funded liability structure with higher sensitivity to global USD funding spreads than retail peers.
Majority 59.4% ownership by Central Bank of Libya constrains rating uplift and governance optics.
Operating footprint includes EM markets with FX/inflation volatility (Egypt, Brazil, Tunisia).
